title: Keynote: Supply & Cost in Next-Gen Electrolytes & Fluorine
gist: Member-only Benchmark Week 2026 video page for a keynote by Do-Fluoride New Materials Vice Chairman Michelle Li (Nov 10, 2026). No transcript; the agenda says it covers market and cost pressures in battery electrolyte salts, capacity outlook, upstream fluorine security, and scaling materials for fast-charging and energy storage.

insights.claim: Do-Fluoride New Materials' Benchmark Week 2026 keynote addresses market and cost pressures in battery electrolyte salts and the capacity outlook for them.
insights.speaker: Michelle Li, Vice Chairman, Do-Fluoride New Materials Co
insights.so_what: Cost pressure in electrolyte salts bears on margins for electrolyte makers such as Do-Fluoride.
insights.quote: market and cost pressures in battery electrolyte salts, capacity outlook

insights.claim: Do-Fluoride's Michelle Li flags upstream fluorine security as a supply-chain issue for battery electrolyte materials.
insights.speaker: Michelle Li, Vice Chairman, Do-Fluoride New Materials Co
insights.so_what: Upstream fluorine availability could limit electrolyte supply, so fluorine chemical producers are a chokepoint worth watching.

insights.claim: The Do-Fluoride keynote links next-generation electrolyte and fluorine materials to scaling for fast-charging batteries and energy storage. The video is member-only and gives no figures.
insights.speaker: Michelle Li, Vice Chairman, Do-Fluoride New Materials Co
insights.so_what: Fast-charging and ESS growth are named as demand vectors for advanced electrolyte materials.
insights.quote: scaling materials for fast-charging and energy storage

source_meta.author: Michelle Li, Vice Chairman, Do-Fluoride New Materials Co
